Oliver Grant: FYI hourly agg for metric `api_latency_p95` has a gap 2026-03-25 22:00-23:30 UTC. Dash shows zeros for tenant group A. Looks like late kafka arrivals from ingest-theta.
Mei Tan: I see it. Upstream made a small change to event key normalization last night. Prefer a targeted preview first.
Priyanka Desai: Agreed. Proposal: 90m window preview on a subset of shards (s[201-203]) with emit_samples=10, checksum, and invalidation preview. If checksum delta < 0.15% we consider promote.
Oliver Grant: Also want the console to show routing label (reserved/background), est CU, and expected wait for each quota_profile in the preview UI. Ops should pick quota with visibility.
Priyanka Desai: I'll queue a preview job with `quota_profile=background` and `emit_invalidation_preview=true`. Internal API: POST /reprocess {"range":"2026-03-25T22:00:00Z/2026-03-25T23:30:00Z","shards":[201,202,203],"preview":true,"emit_samples":10,"quota_profile":"background","emit_invalidation_preview":true} (internal only)
ingest-bot: Detected upstream deployment: events-normalizer v2.1 at 2026-03-25T21:45:12Z
backfill-bot: Job created: preview-1718812345-201 (status: queued)
Mei Tan: Add routing policy: if preview checksum delta > 0.5% => block promote and create a data-platform ticket automatically. If 0.15% < delta <= 0.5% => require manual approval.
Priyanka Desai: Preview started; output will land in s3://telemetry-previews/1718812345/preview-201.jsonl.gz
backfill-bot: Job running: preview-1718812345-201 (status: running)
backfill-bot: Job finished: preview-1718812345-201 (status: success)
Priyanka Desai: Preview results: checksum delta 0.09%. Sample diffs: 6 rows with timestamp normalization. Invalidation preview keys: inv:api_latency_p95:shard:201:20260325T22, inv:api_latency_p95:shard:202:20260325T22
Oliver Grant: Good. Let's promote but schedule during off-peak 02:00-05:00 UTC, quota=fair-share, quota_cap=400 CU, cost_cap=900. Also enable pre-promote smoke that refreshes dashboards after 10% completion.
Mei Tan: Console UX: show a small diff modal with top 5 row diffs, checksum %, routing label and est CU. Add an "invalidate_on_promote" checkbox with preview of keys. PR incoming.
Priyanka Desai: Kicking promote with `invalidate_on_promote=true` and `post_promote_smoke=true`. Curl (internal): curl -X POST https://internal-api/reprocess -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"range":"2026-03-25T22:00:00Z/2026-03-25T23:30:00Z","shards":[201,202,203],"preview":false,"quota":"fair-share","quota_cap":400,"cost_cap":900,"schedule":"2026-03-26T02:30:00Z","invalidate_on_promote":true,"post_promote_smoke":true}'
backfill-bot: Promote run queued: promote-1718812600-201 (status: queued)
Oliver Grant: Monitoring note: if post_promote_smoke shows delta > 0.5% abort and escalate immediately. Keep logs and diffs here.
Mei Tan: I'll watch. If anything odd, route to data-platform and hold further promotes.
Priyanka Desai: Will post final summary after promote completes.
